title: Weighing Conflicting Signals to Set the Right Escalation on a Strategic Account
scenario_text:
An account-health agent at Solstice Analytics must recommend the correct escalation for a strategic account by synthesizing signals across systems.

**Salesforce (CRM)**
Account: 'Copperline Freight' | Tier: Enterprise | ARR: $1.4M | Renewal: 45 days | Health score: 68 (Yellow) | Strategic: Yes | Exec sponsor: CFO.

**Zendesk (Support)**
3 open tickets. #7781 (High): 'Reporting API latency spikes for 5 business days.' Opened by Copperline's data team. Customer comment: 'This is affecting our month-end close.'

**Billing**
Payment status: current. Auto-renew was silently switched from opt-in to opt-out 10 days ago. Seat count reduced 12% at last true-up.

**Slack — #strategic-accounts**
CSM (6 days ago): 'Copperline's analytics lead hinted they're piloting a competing BI tool for month-end reporting.'
Sales Director (reply): 'They floated that last year too and renewed at full value. I wouldn't over-rotate.'

**PagerDuty (Engineering)**
2 SEV-2 incidents on the reporting pipeline in 60 days. Latest RCA: 'Query planner regression; permanent fix shipping in ~3 weeks. Interim mitigation available now.'

**Product usage (Amplitude)**
Weekly active users in the reporting module down 34% over 6 weeks; export-to-CSV usage up 3x (a known workaround pattern before customers offboard reporting).

The Sales Director's read is that the competitive signal is routine. The agent must decide the escalation.
question: What escalation action should the agent recommend for Copperline Freight?
choices: Standard support handling — the reporting issue has an interim mitigation and a permanent fix in ~3 weeks; no broader escalation is warranted
CSM-led QBR only — schedule a business review to walk through the roadmap; the competitive mention is routine per the Sales Director

Executive escalation to the CFO sponsor with a combined briefing covering the reporting incidents, the auto-renew opt-out and seat reduction, the usage decline, and the competitive pilot — with proactive outreach before month-end and the renewal date
Technical escalation only — expedite the query-planner fix and notify the customer of the timeline; the churn signals are premature to act on
